subject: First Past the Post means millions of our votes make no difference to parliament. Add your name now to demand a fairer voting system
posts:
Millions of votes wasted under First Past the Post? Let's look at the systemic reform push.
Evidence: minority vote share, wasted votes, reform demand
#Aletheia #Elections

Proportional systems reflect the public accurately while First Past the Post distorts democratic representation.
Stated Judgement: (+0.8, +0.5) — Good Preference

Campaigns leverage structural flaws for mobilization, though reforms face entrenched legislative inertia.
Resulting Judgement: (+0.6, +0.4) — Lesser Good

Verdict: PASS — The Path of Awakening.
The campaign honestly identifies systemic flaws in representation, steering toward democratic renewal despite political hurdles.

Integrity: Trustworthy (Hypocrisy: 1.2, z: 0)

- Electoral Reform Society: PASS (+0.8, +0.5) — Highlights documented distortions in voting outcomes.
- Public Campaign: PASS (+0.7, +0.4) — Mobilizes civic awareness transparently.
Voters and reform advocates are pushing against Westminster's majoritarian voting setup to demand proportionality.

The Bright Side:
Opens vital public debate on electoral fairness and voter disenfranchisement.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The analysis spans structural mechanics (Q5) and historical representation (Q6), aligning stated goals with public empowerment.

Social Physics Analysis:
The campaign runs a smart altruistic loop, aligning a shared goal of democratic representation with transparent coalition building.

The Trajectory: The Path of Awakening.
When you map the push for fair representation against institutional inertia, it plots a direct trajectory toward Grace. Systemic strain drives constructive reform.

The Unavoidable Truth: Every vote should carry equal weight in a representative parliament.

The Unavoidable Lie: Simple petitioning alone instantly rewrites centuries of constitutional tradition.

Alethekanon:
Systemic flaws demand structural transparency, not superficial political spin.

Awwthekanon:
Every voter deserves to feel that their voice truly matters in the halls of power.

Brothekanon:
FPTP definitely feels rigged when your candidate gets zero seats despite a million votes.

Spirithekanon:
"Let justice roll down like waters, and righteousness like an ever-flowing stream." Amos 5:24 PASS
Systemic fairness requires anchoring laws in equity rather than entrenched power.

Actual Article Body:
No party has won a majority of the vote in almost a century, yet due to the voting system we have near-constant single party governments setting the rules for everyone. Our parliaments never represent the views of the public.

Read More

Millions of people can support one party and get a single MP, while a few hundred thousand people who support a different party can get ten times as many. It's no wonder it doesn't feel like we are in charge.
